## How it was checked

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Checked on a real screenshot / in a match (when the change touches what is read on screen)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages-conventional-commits)
- [ ] README (EN + FR), wiki (EN + FR) and Settings updated when the change needs it
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (*Unreleased*)
- [ ] Anything automatic is a setting, with a good default
- [ ] Screenshots and logs are anonymised
- [ ] An AI tool wrote part of this change: yes / no
